fr_aller_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe waves to his ALLY the porter (ah-LAY) – "let's GO!" – and sets off with his suitcase.
fr_aller_verb.why: Sound-alike 'ally' → aller = to go; the standard Monsieur Verbe mime (striped shirt, beret, white face) acts it out in the painting: suitcase in hand, waving to the porter.

fr_sortir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe leads a SORTIE (sor-TEER) of toy soldiers GOING OUT of the green booth.
fr_sortir_verb.why: A sortie is a going-out → sortir = to go out; the mime marches the soldiers out of the door.

fr_remonter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe REMOUNTS his pony (ruh-mohn-TAY) to ride BACK UP the hill.
fr_remonter_verb.why: Re-mount = get back up → remonter = to go back up; the mime is back in the saddle.

fr_rentrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RAN with a TRAY of cakes (rahn-TRAY) to GO BACK IN to the old streetcar before the cream melts.
fr_rentrer_verb.why: 'Ran tray' sounds like rentrer = to go back in; the mime runs his cake tray in through the green door.

fr_rapprocher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe APPROACHES (rah-proh-SHAY) two shy hedgehogs and BRINGS them CLOSER under the mushroom.
fr_rapprocher_verb.why: Approach → rapprocher = to bring closer; the mime gently nudges the hedgehogs together.

fr_partir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe LEAVES the PARTY (pahr-TEER) with his balloons, waving from the train step.
fr_partir_verb.why: Party → partir = to leave; the mime is leaving the party train. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (par-TEER -> pahr-TEER).

fr_revenir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe COMES BACK from the workshop with his table in a shiny new RE-VENEER.
fr_revenir_verb.why: Re-veneer sounds like revenir = to come back; the mime carries the gleaming table back.

fr_recuperer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe GETS BACK his red ball from the mischievous crow on the roof – he RECUPERATES it.
fr_recuperer_verb.why: Recuperate → récupérer = to get back; the crow drops the ball into the mime's hand.

fr_rattraper_verb.hook: The rat escaped the RAT TRAP – Monsieur Verbe runs to CATCH UP with it.
fr_rattraper_verb.why: Rat-trap → rattraper = to catch up with; the mime chases the rat beside the empty trap.

fr_renoncer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe GIVES UP climbing the clock post – palm out, "NON!" – he RENOUNCES it.
fr_renoncer_verb.why: Renounce → renoncer = to give up; the mime holds out a 'no' hand at the post.

fr_rester_verb.hook: Not 'rest' – Monsieur Verbe holds up his hand and his little dog STAYS on its rug.
fr_rester_verb.why: False friend: rester = to stay; the mime's flat 'stay!' hand and the sitting terrier.

fr_reculer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RECOILS from a cucumber and jumps BACK.
fr_reculer_verb.why: Recoil → reculer = to move back; the mime leaps backwards from the cucumber.

fr_quitter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe leaves the KEY under the mat (kee-TAY) and walks away – he LEAVES the house.
fr_quitter_verb.why: 'Key-tay' → quitter = to leave (a place); the mime slips the key under the mat at the door.

fr_repartir_verb.hook: His parrot's mischievous REPARTEE makes Monsieur Verbe pick up his suitcase and LEAVE AGAIN.
fr_repartir_verb.why: Repartee → repartir = to leave again; the mime sets off once more, parrot on his shoulder.

fr_incliner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BOWS low to his own reflection in his hand mirror – the horse snorts "NAY, show-off!"
fr_incliner_verb.why: Incline = lean/bow → s'incliner = to bow; the mirror shows it is reflexive (se).
ex: Le comédien s'incline devant le public.
The actor bows to the audience.

fr_gravir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe CLIMBS a mountain of mashed potato dripping with GRAVY.
fr_gravir_verb.why: Gravy → gravir = to climb (a slope); the mime scrambles up the potato mountain.

fr_hater_verb.hook: A HATTER in a hurry: Monsieur Verbe HURRIES with a hatbox under his arm, checking himself in his mirror.
fr_hater_verb.why: Hatter → se hâter = to hurry; the mirror shows it is reflexive (se).

fr_empresser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the reporter HASTENS to get his story ON the PRESS (ahn-PRESS-ay), mirror in hand.
fr_empresser_verb.why: Press → s'empresser = to hasten, to be eager; the mirror shows it is reflexive (s').

fr_lasser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe is so LAZY and weary he dozes in a rocking chair – he GROWS TIRED of it all, mirror drooping.
fr_lasser_verb.why: Lazy → se lasser = to grow tired (of); the drooping mirror shows it is reflexive (se).

fr_acceder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe climbs a step ladder to get ACCESS to the cookie jar – he REACHES it every DAY (ak-say-DAY).
fr_acceder_verb.why: Access → accéder = to reach, to get to; the mime reaches up to the jar from his ladder.

fr_exalter_verb.hook: His friends lift Monsieur Verbe and his pet hamster high on their shoulders – he is EXALTED and gets carried away, mirror held high.
fr_exalter_verb.why: Exalt → s'exalter = to get carried away (with excitement); the mirror shows it is reflexive (s').
ex: Il s'exalte en parlant de son voyage.
He gets carried away talking about his trip.

fr_traquer_verb.hook: Detective Monsieur Verbe TRACKS DOWN muddy paw prints with his magnifying glass.
fr_traquer_verb.why: Track → traquer = to track down; the mime follows the prints.

fr_galoper_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe GALLOPS on his pony, a baguette under his arm.
fr_galoper_verb.why: Gallop → galoper = to gallop; the mime gallops past on the pony.

fr_tacher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TRIES HARD at his TASK (tah-SHAY): heaving a huge trunk on a cart.
fr_tacher_verb.why: Task → tâcher (de) = to try hard to; the mime strains at the trunk.

fr_emerger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe EMERGES from a manhole in a hard hat, nose to nose with a mole.
fr_emerger_verb.why: Emerge → émerger = to emerge; the mime pops up out of the manhole.

fr_entreprendre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe UNDERTAKES a trip round the world – a great ENTERPRISE – with his globe, backpack and tortoise.
fr_entreprendre_verb.why: Enterprise → entreprendre = to undertake; the mime sets off with his globe and tortoise.
